subject: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@clearhealth.co>, Tom Yu <tom.yu@nimblelabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps

Hi Elena / Tom —

Great conversation today. Quick recap and a proposed MAP milestone focused on the Integration Build Plan (SDK + streaming + tool-calling + structured outputs). I attached a lightweight MAP worksheet (ClearHealth_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and a starter integration checklist.

High-level ask from ClearHealth: embed Redwood text-generation and tool-calling into their clinician workflow with structured JSON outputs for the EHR. Key constraints we discussed: 99th pct latency target < 400ms on short prompts, support for streaming partial responses to the UI, and server-side tool-calling for lookup actions (patient lookup, med-check).

Proposed MAP milestone: "Integration Build Plan — SDK prototype + streaming"
- Target milestone completion: 2026-12-22 (internal target to align with December pilot window)
- Owners: Dev (SDK & POC) | Karthik (infra & deployment config) | Marissa (customer coordination & acceptance criteria)
- Dependencies: ClearHealth to provide staging dataset + API token; legal signoff on DPA by 2026-12-08; access to a sandbox EHR instance for tool-calling tests; SSO details (SAML) for auth testing.
- Success criteria: SDK sample app + streaming demo, automated regression prompts showing parity with baseline, documented tool-calling handshake and sample structured outputs.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Dev kick-off with ClearHealth engineering this week to scope SDK hooks and streaming settings (owner: Dev).
2) Legal / procurement milestone to target DPA by 12/08 (owner: Marissa).
3) Redwood infra to draft a deployment profile for the pilot (gpu type, quantization, batching policy) (owner: Karthik).
4) Joint POC schedule: target first dev sync week of 11/29 — propose Tue 11/30 at 11am PT.

Elena — could you confirm staging API token availability and whether your security team requires our SOC2 evidence for the pilot?

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Ramos <elena@clearhealth.co>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Yu <tom.yu@nimblelabs.io>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps

Thanks Rafael — that looks good. Quick answers:
- Staging API token: we can provision a token scoped for the pilot by 2026-11-29 if you send the target IP ranges (we prefer scoped tokens over broad keys).
- SOC2 evidence: our security team will want SOC2 Type II and an outline of your data retention policy; we can accept an initial summary for the pilot but will need full docs before production.
- Sandbox EHR: provisioned, but it needs a table mapping for the tool-calling endpoints (I'll share a sample payload).

One ask from our engineering lead: what streaming chunk size do you recommend for interactive UI updates? Also, we expect tool-call round-trips to be <350ms for patient lookup.

We can do Tue 11/30 11am PT for the dev sync. Tom and I will be on the call.

—Elena
Elena Ramos
Director of Product, ClearHealth
elena@clearhealth.co

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@clearhealth.co>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps

Thanks Elena — confirming a couple of items from the GTM side so we can lock the MAP:
- Legal / DPA: I'll engage our contracts manager today and aim for signature by 2026-12-08.
- Commercial: proposed pilot credit: 50k tokens + 2 weeks of dedicated infra we can float while the pilot runs; we will finalize in the contract paperwork.
- Acceptance criteria: I'll add a short acceptance checklist to the MAP sheet: streaming demo, tool-calling test cases (patient lookup + med-check), and a latency report.

Action: Rafael, please add the updated owners into the MAP spreadsheet. Dev — please confirm padded timeline (how many dev days you need) and whether you need a pre-provisioned GPU instance to start.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@clearhealth.co>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps

Acknowledged — quick technical plan and ETA from our side: 
- Week 0 (this week): Dev kickoff with ClearHealth, exchange token/IP and the sandbox EHR mapping. Aim: prototype auth + simple request/response.
- Week 1 (12/06): SDK integration — implement streaming client hooks (JS + Kotlin sample) and validate partial payloads.
- Week 2 (12/13): Tool-calling flow — implement a server-side adapter for patient lookup (sync & async paths) and run latency tests in staging.
- Week 3 (12/20): Structured outputs — add JSON schema validation and regression prompts; prepare demo artifacts.

Estimated dev effort: 3.5 engineer-weeks (Dev to lead, 1 SWE dedicated + 0.5 SWE shared). I will need a pre-provisioned pilot instance (NVIDIA A10x or equivalent) by 12/01 to run realistic latency tests. If procurement can't do that, we can run smaller-scale tests but it may impact the 12/22 milestone.

Dependencies noted: DPA signature (legal), staging token, sandbox EHR mapping, and SAML SSO details if we test auth flows.

I'll post the SDK integration checklist to the shared Drive and link when ready.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Engineer, Integrations — Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration playbook — milestones, owners, and immediate next steps

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick confirmations:
- Marissa: please send the DPA thread/owner to Elena's legal contact and copy me.
- Karthik: can you provision a pilot A10x by 12/01 (or confirm alternative) and share the deployment profile by EOD 11/30?
- Dev: once you have the SDK checklist in Drive, flag the items you need from ClearHealth (token, EHR mapping, SSO) so Elena can turn those over on Monday.

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 11/30 11am PT dev sync to lock it. Looking forward to the pilot — target MAP milestone remains 2026-12-22; we'll keep the contract close target at 2026-12-15 (commercial signoff).

Best — Rafael
